subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous collection of runtime service objects reconstructed from validated function IR: buffered byte writers with checksummed output, Huffman/LZ77 inflate decompression (continuation, table builder, context loader), curve-table generation, parameter/scale configuration objects, scene-graph node lists with flag propagation, frustum culling and visibility masks, fixed-size global initialization loops, particle-buffer initializers, geometry helpers, and a packet-buffer writer. Receiver identities are mostly unknown; the classes below are conservative groupings of functions that share evidenced field layout, call relationships, or lifecycle.

summary: This subsystem groups 29 validated functions into 23 conservative class proposals. A buffered writer cluster (BitBufferWriter) flushes pending 2-byte units and writes checksummed byte sequences. An inflate cluster (InflateDecoder, HuffmanTableBuilder, InflateContextLoader, VirtualSlotDispatcher) decodes a Huffman-coded LZ77 stream through a decode-state machine, continuing across calls. A parameter/scale cluster (ParamScalingObject, FieldTripletSource) configures a flagged object whose three scale parameters drive three float groups. Scene-graph facilities (SceneGraphNode, SceneGraphContainer, FrustumCullNode, SceneModeObject, VisibilityMaskFilter) propagate flags, clear node masks, and cull against frustum planes. Two list containers (DListNodeList, DListChain), two global-array initializers (GlobalArrayInitializer), particle-buffer initializers (ParticleBufferObject), geometry helpers (TrianglePointTester, MathVectorOps, SplineCurveGenerator), a scene-state factory (SceneStateManager), a UI state setter (RenderUiStateObject), an audio dispatcher (AudioPlaybackDispatcher), and a packet writer (NetworkPacketBuffer) round out the set. Every owner is UNKNOWN at IR level; class memberships are DERIVED/GUESS proposals from field overlap, shared callers, and call edges.

function_roles.role: Flushes a pending 2-byte unit and its pending-count dword from the writer into the output buffer, clearing the pending state; the flush path is selected by the pending count threshold.

Writes a checksummed byte sequence: flushes the sink via UnicodeBufferFlusher, sets a mode field, appends a 4-byte one's-complement integrity trailer for the payload, and copies payload bytes into the growable buffer.

Inflate decode continuation: jump-table dispatch over the decode state machine (literal/length, extra bits, distance, copy, flush, error), decoding symbols via the shared lookup table and copying matches and output bytes.
Generic indirect dispatch thunk: calls the function pointer stored at +0x24 of the receiver with the context pointer at +0x28, returning the callee's result.

Canonical-Huffman table builder: counts code lengths, detects canonical overflow (-3), builds cumulative offsets, orders symbols by length, and constructs linked decoder nodes with an escape marker, returning -4/-5 on structural errors.
Loads four inflate context globals into caller outputs: values dword_5DA998 and dword_5DA99C, and addresses of unk_5DA9A0 and unk_5DB9A0.

Huffman/LZ77 decode core: walks length/literal and distance trees, refills the bit accumulator, emits literals, copies LZ77 back-references across the window, and reports invalid codes through the error strings into the caller's error slot.
Generates a normalized curve lookup table of {t, delta} pairs over the entry count, evaluating the curve function per step and fixing the final entry to t=1.0.
Reads three consecutive DWORD fields (+0x4/+0x8/+0xC) into caller outputs, each write gated independently on its output pointer being non-null.
Reads three consecutive DWORD fields (+0x1C/+0x20/+0x24) into caller outputs, each write gated independently on its output pointer being non-null; returns the third output pointer.
Sets bit 1 of the flags word at +0 and stores three parameters into +0x1C/+0x20/+0x24; always executes fully and returns the last parameter.
Conditionally applies three scale factors to three float groups, gated on and clearing bit 1 of the flags word; returns the original flags value read at entry.

Conditional state integer quad-setter: writes four consecutive state fields at +0x1508..+0x1514, each stored only when its matching argument is non-negative so a caller can pass -1 to leave a field untouched.

Audio playback dispatcher: forwards seven arguments to one of three handlers selected by an eighth selector (7 -> sub_5609DE, 8 -> sub_560A82, otherwise sub_560410), returning the selected handler's result.

Scene-state creation: guarded by the flag at +0x13D8, builds a 26-dword parameter block by mode, invokes vtable slot 0xB0 on the factory object at +0x1100, and increments the counter at +0x13B4 on success.
Doubly-linked list node removal: patches prev->next (+76) and next->prev (+72), advancing the head at +0x108 when the removed node is the head.
Clears a scene-graph flag on every node of two node lists (heads at +0x100/+0x108) and their sub-nodes via BitmaskClear and SceneGraphFlagPropagation.
Appends a node to a chain rooted at +0xEC, walking +0x4C next pointers to the tail, linking the new node back through +0x48 and zeroing +0x44/+0x4C.
Tests an AABB's 8 corners against 6 frustum planes and writes visibility flags to +0x4: bit 0 fully visible, bit 1 fully culled, bit 2 partial.
Two-valued mode setter rewriting the word at +0xEC with mode bit 0x1000 or 0x2000 (masking the other off), returning a2 for the 4096/other branches and the rewritten word for the 0x2000 branch.
Propagates flag bits into the node flag at +0x3C, its child-list structure at +0x204, a related node at +0x44 (recursively), and up through parents at +0x4C while the walk flag is set.

Visibility/permission mask filter: passes unconditionally when its own mask at +0x38 is zero, otherwise only when every set bit of +0x38 is present in the global render mask and the target object's mask.
Fixed 256-iteration initialization loop walking global unk_8BF740 backward in 104-byte steps, invoking EmptyStub_b160 each iteration.
Fixed 256-iteration initialization loop walking global dword_8C5F40 backward in 104-byte steps, invoking EmptyStub_b160 each iteration.
Allocation-time initializer: zeroes the leading dwords (+0x0..+0xC, +0x1C..+0x24) and the 0x40-byte block at +0x34, returning the this pointer.
Allocation-time initializer: zeroes the first five dwords (+0x0..+0x10), returning the this pointer.
Point-in-triangle test over a projected 2D plane with six selector modes; modes 4-5 delegate the three edge tests to F_2DCrossProduct, returning 1 when all edge tests pass.
Pure 2D cross-product helper: computes the z-component of the cross product of the edge vectors restricted to two coordinate-axis indices, returned as a double.

Publishes six dwords from a source struct into the entry at a slot index of a fixed-stride (116-byte) packet buffer via the descriptor at +0x1E0, marking the entry dirty through bit 3 of its flags, bounded by the descriptor count.

classes.name: BitBufferWriter
classes.responsibility: Buffered byte writer that accumulates a pending 2-byte unit and a pending-count dword, flushes them into an output buffer at a write position, and can precede payload writes with a 4-byte one's-complement checksum trailer.

classes.name: InflateDecoder
classes.responsibility: Stateful inflate decoder that consumes a Huffman-coded bitstream with LZ77 back-references, continuing across calls via the decode state at +0, the remaining-match-length at +4, the bit accumulator at +8, and the bit count at +0x18; invalid codes surface error strings.

classes.name: HuffmanTableBuilder
classes.responsibility: Builds canonical Huffman tables from per-symbol code lengths: counts lengths, checks canonical overflow, orders symbols, and constructs linked 16-bit decoder nodes with escape markers and a node-count cap.

classes.name: InflateContextLoader
classes.responsibility: Provides the four static inflate context globals (two value dwords and two table addresses) to the pipeline's frame path via caller outputs.

classes.name: VirtualSlotDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Generic indirect dispatch thunk: calls the function pointer at +0x24 with the context pointer at +0x28 of the receiver, forwarding one pass-through argument.

classes.name: SplineCurveGenerator
classes.responsibility: Generates a normalized curve lookup table of {t, delta} pairs over the entry count at +0, storing a curve parameter at +8 and filling the buffer at +0xC by evaluating the curve function per step.

classes.name: ParamScalingObject
classes.responsibility: Parameterized object with an enable flag bit at +0, three scale parameters at +0x1C/+0x20/+0x24, and three groups of three float values at +0x28..+0x50 that are scaled when the flag bit is set; also exposes its three parameters for read-back.

classes.name: FieldTripletSource
classes.responsibility: Exposes three consecutive DWORD fields at +0x4/+0x8/+0xC to caller-provided output pointers, each gated on its pointer being non-null.

classes.name: RenderUiStateObject
classes.responsibility: UI-render state object exposing four consecutive conditionally-settable state integers at +0x1508..+0x1514; each is written only when the matching argument is non-negative.

classes.name: AudioPlaybackDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Dispatches an audio playback request to one of three handlers selected by an eight-argument selector, forwarding seven arguments unchanged.

classes.name: SceneStateManager
classes.responsibility: Creates scene-state objects through a vtable-bearing factory at +0x1100 (slot 0xB0), gated by the flag at +0x13D8, parameterized by a 26-dword block, and counted at +0x13B4.

classes.name: DListNodeList
classes.responsibility: Doubly-linked list container whose head is at +0x108; nodes link backward through +72 and forward through +76, and removal advances the head when the head node is removed.

classes.name: SceneGraphContainer
classes.responsibility: Container holding two scene-graph node lists (heads at +0x100/+0x108) whose nodes and sub-nodes carry flags cleared via BitmaskClear and SceneGraphFlagPropagation.

classes.name: DListChain
classes.responsibility: Node chain rooted at +0xEC; nodes link forward through +0x4C, backward through +0x48, with an extra zeroed word at +0x44 on every append.

classes.name: FrustumCullNode
classes.responsibility: Cullable scene object carrying an AABB (8 corners of 3 floats at +0x24) and a visibility flag word at +0x4 updated from signed-plane tests against the camera frustum.

classes.name: SceneModeObject
classes.responsibility: Object with a two-valued mode word at +0xEC selecting mode 0x1000 or 0x2000; used by camera viewport and scene-file parsing paths.

classes.name: SceneGraphNode
classes.responsibility: Scene-graph node that propagates flag bits to itself (flags at +0x3C), its child-list structure at +0x204, a related node at +0x44, and upward through parents at +0x4C.

classes.name: VisibilityMaskFilter
classes.responsibility: Visibility filter that passes when its own mask at +0x38 is a subset of the global render mask and the target object's mask, or passes unconditionally when the own mask is zero.

classes.name: GlobalArrayInitializer
classes.responsibility: Runs a fixed 256-iteration per-element initialization over a global array, stepping backward 104 bytes per element and invoking the empty stub each iteration; two sibling instances target unk_8BF740 and dword_8C5F40.

classes.name: ParticleBufferObject
classes.responsibility: Fixed-size particle-buffer object whose leading dwords (+0x0..+0x10, +0x1C..+0x24) and the 0x40-byte block at +0x34 are zeroed at allocation time; grouped from two initializers sharing the VertexParticleBufferAllocator caller.

classes.name: TrianglePointTester
classes.responsibility: Point-in-triangle test over a projected 2D plane: reads the point at +0x0/+0x4/+0x8, reads three triangle vertex pointers from the triangle object (+0x0/+0x4/+0x8), dispatches on a six-mode selector, and returns inside/outside via signed-area edge tests.

classes.name: MathVectorOps
classes.responsibility: Pure 2D cross-product helper computing the z-component of the cross product of two edge vectors restricted to two coordinate-axis indices, consumed for signed-area point-in-triangle tests.

classes.name: NetworkPacketBuffer
classes.responsibility: Publishes six-dword state entries into a fixed-stride (116-byte) packet buffer behind a descriptor at +0x1E0, bounded by the element count and marking entries dirty via bit 3 of their flags.

states.name: CopyOrLiteral
states.description: State 0: initial copy/literal dispatch entry of the jump table

states.name: LengthExtraBits
states.description: State 2: extra bits consumed for the length value

states.name: DistanceExtraBits
states.description: State 4: extra bits consumed for the distance value

states.name: Error
states.description: State 9: error terminal referencing the invalid-literal / invalid-distance strings

transitions.on: length-tree terminal decodes a length code
match copied, loop back to jump-table dispatch
invalid literal or distance code encountered

interfaces.name: IHuffmanInflate
interfaces.purpose: Contract for decoding a Huffman-coded, LZ77-compressed bitstream: decode continuation, tree walking, and match copying are invoked from the shared inflate pipeline (callers StateResetWithCallback 0x00537000 and sub_537110 0x00537110).

interfaces.name: IByteSink
interfaces.purpose: Contract for a byte sink that accumulates pending bytes and flushes them into an output buffer, optionally writing a one's-complement checksum trailer ahead of payload bytes.

compatibility_contracts.name: InflateDecodeStateMachineContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The inflate decoder must preserve the decode-state field at +0 and the jump-table dispatch semantics (copy/literal, length, extra bits, distance, copy, flush, error) so multi-call continuation works across the pipeline; invalid literal and distance codes must surface the error strings aInvalidLiteral_0 / aInvalidDistanc_0.

compatibility_contracts.name: ChecksummedByteWriteContract
compatibility_contracts.description: WriteChecksummedBytes flushes pending bytes through UnicodeBufferFlusher and appends a 4-byte integrity trailer ordered low, high, one's-complement low, one's-complement high; a replacement writer must reproduce this byte order for compatible output.

compatibility_contracts.name: PacketEntryDirtyFlagContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Packet entries use a 116-byte stride with a flags word whose bit 3 marks an entry dirty; the descriptor count bounds the slot index. A replacement must keep the entry layout and the dirty-bit protocol.

compatibility_contracts.name: SceneGraphFlagPropagationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Flag propagation must OR node flags at +0x3C, child-list flags, related-node flags at +0x44, and walk parents at +0x4C, terminating when the parent chain ends.

unresolved: Meaning of the count threshold (8) in the pending-count branch of UnicodeBufferFlusher is not grounded; both branches clear the pending state identically.
WriteChecksummedBytes operates on an untyped growable buffer (v5[2] base, v5[5] cursor) and a mode field at this+0x16A7; buffer capacity and the field semantics are not evidenced.
Whether the flushed byte stream is genuine UTF-16/Unicode or a byte protocol named after the flusher is unresolved.
The raw source of InflateHuffmanDecodeCont is truncated mid-function, so the full per-state bit orders and copy loops are not fully evidenced.
The exact Huffman table encoding behind dword_5DBB90 is not evidenced in this packet.
The 0x20 terminal flag and the window-base/boundary roles of a5[10]/a5[11] in HuffmanLZ77Decode are DERIVED-level interpretations; the a1/a2 mask-table indices are unresolved.

HuffmanLZ77Decode threads its bit/output state through caller-supplied structures (a5[7]/a5[8]/a5[13], a6[0..2]) rather than a stable this; those offsets are not attached to the InflateDecoder class fields.
VirtualSlotDispatcher's receiver object and the concrete virtual method at vtable slot +0x24 are unknown; the callee is indirect so the callgraph lists no static callee.
sub_53A020's parameters a4/a5/a6/a7/a8/a9/a10 outside the Huffman-table reading, the 80/96 offsets applied to the a5 byte values, and the 0x5A0 node cap are not established.
The spline curve parameter at SplineCurveGenerator+0x8, the endpoint words at +8/+12 of the final slot, and the curve data layout are unproven.
ParamScalingObject's three float groups and the returned-flags contract with caller sub_558E70 have no named semantics; the un-scaled float slots between groups are untouched.

ThreeFieldBatchGetter (0x0053B170) reads +0x4/+0x8/+0xC and shares caller sub_558E70 with ParamScalingObject, but common ownership with the +0x1C/+0x20/+0x24 object is not proven, so it is kept as a separate class.
RenderUiStateObject's four state fields at +0x1508..+0x1514 have no named role beyond being dword state slots.
DispatchAudioPlayback's selector (a8) is present but absent from each callee's signature; the selector likely encodes a playback mode consumed indirectly. Argument semantics are unevidenced.
SceneStateManager's 26-dword parameter block layout, the three mode groups, and the guard flag at +0x13D8 are unknown; the literals 1065353216/-1082130432 are not decoded per evidence rules.

DListNodeList (+0x108 head, node links +72/+76) and DListChain (+0xEC head, node links +0x48/+0x4C) both serve caller ArithmeticComparison_9170 but use different node layouts; whether they are the same list type is unproven.
FrustumCullNode's frustum plane layout at a2+260 is inferred from pointer arithmetic only; the +0x4 visibility bit meanings are proposed from existing analysis, not independently confirmed.
SceneModeObject's mode bits at +0xEC have no reader evidence in the packet; the field is only written by 0x0054A160 within this packet.
SceneGraphNode fields +0x214/+0x218 are listed by the deterministic extractor but do not appear in the raw source; their role in the traversal is unclear.
Bitmask_Permission_Check reads the target mask at a2+132 without a field evidence entry; the global render-mask role of dword_8B8E34 is proposed from existing analysis.

GlobalArrayInitializer's stepped pointer is never passed to EmptyStub_b160; whether the callee reads it via another path or the pointer is vestigial is unknown, and the 104-byte stride semantics are unproven.
ParticleBufferObject merges two initializers (0x0054EAF0, 0x0054EB20) based on the shared VertexParticleBufferAllocator caller (0x0054F830); same-class ownership is a grouping proposal, not proven.
TrianglePointTester's projection plane and winding direction per selector are DERIVED; packet-listed fields this+0xC/+0x10 are never read in the raw source.
NetworkPacketBuffer's six copied dwords and the dirty-bit-3 protocol semantics depend on an unevidenced network/state protocol.
The two FixedArrayInitializationLoop sibling loops (0x0054C2A0 over unk_8BF740, 0x0054C300 over dword_8C5F40) are grouped as one class by identical shape; their relationship is unproven.
LoadFourGlobalPtrs accepts an unused parameter a5 and the semantic role of the four globals (constants vs table pointers) is not established.
